ingameEffects.label: Nitro-Fuel Cocktail (Core Passive)
ingameEffects.description:
When Burnice expends Energy, she accumulates Heat, up to a max of 100. She gains 1.4 Heat for each 1 point of Energy consumed. At 50 Heat, she enters the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state until all Heat is expended. Upon entering the battlefield, Burnice instantly accumulates 100 Heat.

While in the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state, when Burnice hits an enemy with a Basic Attack: Mixed Flame Blend, EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method, EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot, Chain Attack: Fuel-Fed Flame, or Ultimate: Glorious Inferno, she applies the Scorched effect to the target until she exits the Nitro-Fuel Cocktail state. When other squad members hit enemies under the Scorched status, it triggers the Afterburn effect, expending 8 Heat to deal Fire DMG equal to 350% of Burnice's ATK and accumulate Fire Anomaly Buildup. This effect can trigger once every 1.5s. For every 10 Anomaly Proficiency, Afterburn DMG increases by 1%, up to a max of 30%. DMG from the Afterburn effect is considered Assist DMG.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: This ability is available in the Damage Calculator.

ingameEffects.label: Kindred Flames (Mindscape Cinema N°1)
ingameEffects.description: Increases the limit of Heat from 100 to 140. Upon entering the battlefield, Burnice accumulates an additional 40 Heat. Increases the DMG Multiplier of the Afterburn effect by 100% of Burnice's ATK. Additionally, the accumulated Fire Anomaly Buildup from the Afterburn effect is increased by 25%.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: This ability is available in the Damage Calculator.

ingameEffects.label: Extra at No Additional Charge (Mindscape Cinema N°2)
ingameEffects.description: When triggering the Afterburn effect, Thermal Penetration is applied to the enemy, stacking up to 5 times and lasting 6s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When any allied unit in the squad hits the enemy, the attack's PEN Ratio is increased by 4% for each stack of Thermal Penetration, up to a max of 20%.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: Allies' PEN Ratio from their attacks is increased by 4%, stacking up to 5 times.

ingameEffects.label: Ultimate Fuel Supply (Mindscape Cinema N°4)
ingameEffects.description: When an EX Special Attack or Assist hits an enemy, the move's CRIT Rate increases by 30%. The max flame spray duration of EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot is increased by 1s.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: This mindscape cinema does not affect Burnice's stats.

ingameEffects.label: Burning Invitation (Mindscape Cinema N°6)
ingameEffects.description: When Burnice hits an enemy with EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot, it triggers an additional special Afterburn effect, dealing 60% of Burnice's ATK as Fire DMG to the target. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s and does not consume Heat. After hitting an enemy with EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot, while the move is active, EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot, special Afterburn effects, and Burn effects will ignore 25% of the target's Fire RES. When EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot's fire blast hits an enemy, if that enemy is Burned, trigger an additional instance of Burn DMG equal to 1,800% of the original DMG. This effect can trigger once every 20s for each target.
ingameEffects.shortDescription: Burnice's EX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot, Afterburn Effects and Burn ignore 25% of the target's Fire RES.

basicAttacks.name: Direct Flame Blend (Basic Attack)
basicAttacks.description:
Press [BASIC] to activate:

Unleashes up to 5 attacks in front, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG.

basicAttacks.name: Mixed Flame Blend (Basic Attack)
basicAttacks.description:
In the /bNitro-Fuel Cocktail//b state, press and hold [BASIC] to activate:

Spin continuously while spraying flames around, followed by a finishing blow that inflicts Fire DMG. Continuing to hold extends the flame-spraying duration. When the move is activated, it consumes 20 /bHeat//b; Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill. After executing the move, pressing [EX] will directly chain into /bEX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot//b.

dashAttacks.name: Dangerous Fermentation (Dash Attack)
dashAttacks.description:
Press [BASIC] during a dodge to activate:

Perform a forward thrust with the flamethrower, causing Fire DMG.

dodgeCounters.name: Fluttering Steps (Dodge Counter)
dodgeCounters.description:
Press [BASIC] during a [COUNTER] to activate:

Launch a series of attacks on enemies in front while spraying flames, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssists.name: Energizing Specialty Drink (Quick Assist)
quickAssists.description:
When the on-field character is launched, press [ASSIST] to activate:

Unleash a flurry of attacks on enemies in front while spraying flames, dealing Physical DMG and Fire DMG. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: Scorching Dew (Assist Follow-Up)
assistFollowup.description:
Press [BASIC] after a [PERFECT] to activate:

Leap into the air and quickly spin forward while spraying flames in all directions, dealing Fire DMG. After using the skill, press [EX] to immediately follow up with /bEX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot//b. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

specialAttacks.name: Intense Heat Aging Method (Special Attack)
specialAttacks.description:
Press [SPECIAL] to activate:

Unleash a fire blast forward, inflicting Fire DMG; Press and hold [SPECIAL] to charge, boosting the move's potency. Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

exSkills.name: Intense Heat Stirring Method (EX Special Attack)
exSkills.description:
With enough energy, press [EX] to activate:

Continuously spray flames with a one-handed flamethrower, then release a fire blast in a straight line ahead, causing massive Fire DMG. Continue holding to steadily consume energy and extend the spray's duration. While continuously spraying, drag the joystick to execute a sidestep dodge, adjusting your position in the corresponding direction.

Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while continuously spraying, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%. Invincibility is granted during sidestep dodge and fire blast.

exSkills.name: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot (EX Special Attack)
exSkills.description:
When activating /bEX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method//b with enough Energy, press [EX] to activate:

Use a dual-handed flamethrower to continuously spray flames, followed by a fire blast in a front line, dealing massive Fire DMG. Keep holding to continue consuming Energy and extend the spray's duration. Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while spraying, and DMG received is reduced by 40%. Invincibility is granted during the fire blast.

chainAttacks.name: Fuel-Fed Flame (Chain Attack)
chainAttacks.description:
When a [CHAIN] is triggered, select the character to activate:

Quickly dash forward while spraying flames, then launch a fire blast in a fan-shaped area ahead, dealing massive Fire DMG. After using the skill, press [EX] to immediately follow up with /bEX Special Attack: Intense Heat Stirring Method - Double Shot//b. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: Glorious Inferno (Ultimate)
ultimate.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [ULTIMATE] to activate:

Dash forward quickly, then leap into the air and continuously spray flames over a wide area ahead, dealing massive Fire DMG. When leaping into the air, a /bQuick Assist//b will be triggered. If the /bQuick Assist//b is triggered, Burnice will spray flames for an extended duration. Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
